title: Constructible and rational forms of normalized integral pullback comparisons
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E$ and $M$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their coefficient rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $\iota:E\to M$ be a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra homomorphism. Fix a normalized comparison system $C$ of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Use the constructible integral pullbacks and the raw rational pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], with raw localization $Q_E$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. For $Z\xrightarrow hW\xrightarrow kV$, with $\ell$ invertible in every residue field, define the constructible compositor as the full-subcategory lift of the specified integral compositor $c^C_{h,k}$. Define its rational compositor at $K\in D^b_c(V,E)$ by $\theta_{h k,K}\,Q_E(c^C_{h,k,K.obj})\,\theta_{h,Q_E(k^*K.obj)}^{-1}\,h^*(\theta_{k,K}^{-1})$ in left-to-right composition order, where $\theta_{f,K}:f^*K\simeq Q_E(f^*K.obj)$ is the prescribed raw-localization object comparison [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. For any $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible, define the rational scalar natural isomorphism $f_E^*\mathbin{\circ}T_X\simeq T_Y\mathbin{\circ}f_M^*$ in left-to-right functor notation as the natural isomorphism whose component at every $K$ is, under the prescribed object formulas of rational pullback and rational scalar extension (identities of objects), $Q_M(a^C_{f,K.obj})$; its naturality for every rational morphism is a stated property of these components. Here $T$ is the recorded raw rational scalar extension and $a^C$ is the specified integral scalar comparison, restricted to the constructible subcategories. The components are these localized integral comparisons themselves; no independent natural isomorphism is chosen, and they determine the natural isomorphism uniquely.

proof.text: For the specified system C, express lambda and mu as components of composites of whiskered realization and counit natural transformations. Their component formulas are precisely integralComparisonLambda and integralComparisonMu. Cancel the invertible mu component to obtain naturality of lambda followed by mu inverse, i.e. integralComparisonScalar. This holds for every C, without choosing another coherent system.

The object and pure-tensor clauses for rational pullback and rational scalar extension identify the two composite functors with the raw localizations of their integral composites, including the image of each scalar under E into M. The prescribed scalar component is heterogeneously equal to the localization of the integral comparison.

Induct on a rational morphism in its tensor-product Hom group. The zero and sum cases follow from additivity. On a pure tensor, the localized composition formula reduces the two composites to the image scalar tensored with the two sides of integral naturality from the first step. Thus the prescribed components are natural. NatIso.ofComponents supplies the specified rational scalar natural isomorphism.
